# Portfolio

> Personal developer portfolio with a private admin panel, built with Astro (SSR), Tailwind CSS,
> React islands, and Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage). Deployed on Vercel.

Content (profile, projects, experience, skills) is stored in Supabase and edited from `/admin`.
Public pages are server-rendered and read only published rows through Row Level Security.
The contact form saves messages to the database.

## Stack

- Astro 7 (output: server) with the Vercel adapter
- Tailwind CSS, React 19 (LetterGlitch hero effect)
- Supabase: Auth (email/password, sign-ups disabled), Postgres with RLS, Storage bucket `project-images`
- Montserrat (teks) dan Lora (judul), keduanya self-hosted. Lora memakai lisensi SIL OFL 1.1.
